tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// dpal chen rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs pa lags so//

oṃ sarba swa sti siddhi hūm̐/ e ma ho/ dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba sras bcas kyi// mdzad pa 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pas// nyid las byon pa'i grub chen brgyad la sogs// kun kyi nang nas brdzus skyes slob dpon nyid// padma rgyal pos byin brlabs dus mtha' yi// rnal 'byor bdag dang gzhan pa yi/ skal ldan 'byung zhes mdzad pa po// u rgyan dbang phyug bla ma rje la 'dud// yun ring dbang gis 'khor ba thog med nas// bdag blo dmu rgod ma rig 'thibs pos bsgrib// de phyir yun ring don mchog ma rtogs kyang*// bstan pa 'di 'di rtsod ldan dang po'i dus// rdzogs ldan dang po ent+ra bhāo ti yi// rjes 'jug mthong na yid du 'ong ba nas// drin chen 'dzam gling yongs grags yan chod du// bsam gyis mi khyab til sbyang nang nas ni// lo re bzhin du til phyungs zad tsam na// zad pa mtha' yas bsam gyis mi khyab par// yang dag don la 'pho 'gyur ma byung gsung*// dus mtha'i rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje ni// dus na sgrib g.yogs 'thibs pos bsgribs pa'i phyir// snga phyi'i dus rnams rgyas par ma dran yang*// sngon mas bskul phyir cung zad tsam gcig bris// de la sngon gyi dus na rgya gar gyi yul du skyes pa yin pa mang po gcig dran par 'dug dpang po med pa'i phyir bzlas kyang the tshom can rnams yid ches par mi 'gyur/ skabs su cung zad las/ shrī ka ma la shi la'i gtsug lag khang du/ mkhan po nyi ma'i snying po dang*/ slob dpon a ka ra si ti gnyis kyi drung du dge tshul byas shing*/ yul gzhan zhig tu phyin pas slob dpon gcig dang mjal/ slob dpon des klu sgrub zhes grags pa de yin pa 'dra/ de'i rjes la slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi slob ma/ dpal rta mgrin la nus pa thob cing*/ sprul pa sna tshogs ston nus pa gcig yin par snang*/ gzhan yang de'i dus su rdzu 'phrul dang nus pa sna tshogs pas 'gro ba'i don byed pa dang*/

'ga' dang 'ga' zhig dran par 'dug ste/ mang po brjod pas yid ches par su zhig 'gyur/ khyad par du yang de'i dus su ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs zhes grags pa de dang dus mtshungs pa yin pa 'dra/ yang gnyug ma skye 'gag med pa'i ngang nas gzugs sku'i 'phrin las sna tshogs su ston pa las/ bar skabs gcig tu rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor pa/ 'dar ma bod de zhes bya ba de dang dus mtshungs pa yin pa 'dra/ de yang thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don byed cing*/ gdul bya mi rnams la snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ston pa de lta bu gcig byung ba yin pa 'dra/ gzhan yang de ma gtogs pa dus gsum gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ mchog thob pa'i grub chen brgyad/ gzhan yang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug grangs las 'das pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ rje ka ma la shi la de dang 'brel ba yod pas/ de'i slob ma rang yang yin zhing*/ gdams pa cung zad thob pa yin pa 'dra/ don med pa mang pos ci zhig bya/ gzhan yang bka' gdams kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen pu to ba chen po de yin snyam pa yang byung*/ de'i dus su kha rag sgom chung zhes grags pa de dang yang dus mtshungs pa yin pa 'dra/ de'i bag chags kyi lhag mas ding sang yang kha rag pa'i gdams pa rnams mthong ba tsam gyis go ba phun sum tshogs pa rgyud la skye bar 'dug /de ma gtogs pa yang sne zur ba chen po zhes grags pa de dang yang 'brel ba gcig yod pa 'dra/ gzhan yang de ma gtogs pa yang 'ga' dang 'ga' zhig dran par 'dug ste/ dpang po med pa'i phyir su zhig yid ches par 'gyur/ gzhan yang dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa dang*/ rin po che karma pa dang tha dad med pa de nyid skabs skabs su rang nyid yin snyam pa byung*/ gzhan yang dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i gdams ngag rnams rang bzhin gyis shes shing rang bzhin gyis go ba dang shes pa byung*/ de ma gtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi tris byin gyis brlabs pa/

rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor chos kyi dbang phyug zhes bya ba gcig tu gyur nas/ gar 'gro gar 'dug cha med par gdul bya rnams la dag pa'i snang ba dpag tu med pa// ston pa gcig byung ba 'dra/ gzhan yang 'gro ba'i mgon pos sems can thams cad la brtse ba chen po dang ldan pas gzigs pa/ karma pa chen po de nyid kyis gdams pa rlung sems kyi gnad mthong ba dang thos pa tsam gyis shes shing phyogs med go ba la sogs pa 'dug ste/ de'i don gyis da ltar yang dus gsum mkhyen pa'i gdan sa rnams gso'i zhing sku gsum ngo sprod kyi gnad kyis smin cing grol ba'i lam khyad par can ston pa ste/ de'i don gyis deng sang yang phyogs med du sems can gyi don byed pa ste/ gdul bya mi rnams thams cad gyis rlung sems kyi gnad phyogs med du go zhing rtogs nas mkhyen par 'gyur ro// de yan chad kyis sngar 'das pa'i skye ba song nas// yang bar de'i rnam par thar pa ni/ lug lo zla ba gcig pa'i dus nas cung zad khams ma bde ba dang*/ ming yongs su grags pa karma pa yang zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i ltas dang chos 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing*/ 'ja' tshon gyi lus nam mkha' la 'phags te/ steng lha'i yul du phyin pa dang*/ lha'i sgra snyan dang rol mo sna tshogs pas bsu ba byed cing*/ lha'i gdugs dpag tu med pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i snang ba 'dug cing der 'dug pas/ sems can rnams la snying rje tshad med pa bsgom zhing*/ skye ba med pa'i ngang nas 'gag pa med pa'i rtsal sbyong zhing gnas pa'i dus su/ zhing skyong 'gro ma nyi shu rtsa lnga 'ongs nas/ nyams kyi snang ba la 'di skad zer zhing 'dug go /khyed dal 'byor gyi mi lus blang re ran// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bzung re ran// 'gro drug gi pha ma bya re ran// dus la bab bo sa ma ya/

de skad zer zhing 'dug pa mthong nas/ 'di 'khrul pa'i snang ba yin snyam pa byung nas/ rnam rtog bshigs kyang mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'gro ru ma 'dod/ khong rnams kyi lan gzhal ba de/ khyed 'ongs pa gang nas 'ongs pa yin// khyed rnams 'di ru ci byed 'ongs// dal 'byor mi lus blang du pha ma med// sangs rgyas bstan pa bzung du shes rab med// 'gro drug gi pha ma bya ru las 'phro med/ lung bstan gyi rgyal tshab gzhan du tshal lo// de skad ces smras pa yis/ khong rnams na re/ nged 'ongs pa mi yul mthil nas 'ongs// yin pa zhi zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro yin/ mi khyod la bskul ma mi 'tshal ste// 'gro drug gi don du bskul du 'ongs/ zer nas rang rang gi ming dang srog gi snying po phul ba ni/ gsang ba rdo rje thog 'bebs ma// gtsug na rdo rje dpal 'bar ma// mtha' na rdo rje stobs mo che// lag na rdo rje mthu rgyal ma/ kha na rdo rje dung sgra ma/ nged zhing skyong gi gtso mo chen mo lnga// bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje grags ma// gangs kyi yum chen kun tu bzang*// dpal ldan rdo rje ha ri ya ma skyong*// 'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso/ bdud 'dul gtso mo chen mo bzhi'i// gtud la 'gro bzang ma// mi g.yo rdo rje glang bzang ma// bkra shis rdo rje tshe bsring ma// stag gzig rdo rje khyung mgo ma// chos srungs gtso mo chen mo bzhi// gangs dkar sha med rdo rje spyan gcig ma// gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje rlung mo che// kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum// rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje grag mo rgyal// gdon 'dul gtso mo chen mo bzhi// sa tri rdo rje 'bri bzangs ma/ tāg sha dung gi rdo rje sgo mo che// chags so rdo rje stobs mo che// gha gha rdo rje rol mo gri// sgo bzhi srung ba'i gtso mo bzhi// kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyongs// btsan la la ro rdo rje sman gcig ma// ma btsun khug chos rdo rje dbyar mo bsil/

g.yu yi sked snyan rdo rje si le ma// yid 'gyur gyi gtso mo chen mo bzhi// nged kyis khyed te ma khul na// rogs kyang mang du sbran no skad// rogs ci ltar sbron bgyis pas// sbas pa'i yul gzhi bsrung ba yi// gtso mo chen mo bzhi dang ni// chos skyong mgon po ber nag can/ des kyang khul bar ma gyur na// bar snang lha bran man chad nas// sa 'og lto 'phye yan chod bar// 'jig rten srid pa gang yang khul// de skad zer zhing 'dug thos nas// 'o na rogs bos dang byas pas// bud med chen mo bzhi 'ongs nas// bzhi ni rdo rje sa dri yin// de 'og li btsun rdo rje bu skyong ma// de 'og rdo rje phu chu sman gcig ma// de 'og rdo rje g.yu chung lags// sbas pa'i yul bzhi bsrung ba'i gtso mo bzhi// chos skyong mgon po ber nag can// mya ngan mi 'da' sku dang grib mar stod// de skad zer zhing 'dug lags pas// bskul 'debs kyi tshigs de 'di skad du// 'gro drug gi sems can snying re rje// 'khor ba'i gnas na nyon re mongs// sems can gyi 'gro don bya re ran// zhes pa'i tshigs de skad zer zhing snang ba'i dus su/ bag chags dang 'phrul pa yin snyam nas/ rnam rtog bshigs kyang 'gror ma 'dod/ de yang yang bskul gyin 'dug pa'i tshe/ kho bos lan gzhal pa/ bdag 'dzin gyi rnam rtog brag bas sra/ nga rgyal ri bo gnam bas mtho/ 'di la thos pa'i gzong btsugs nas// bsgom pa'i sgyogs gcig brgyab lags kyang*// 'jig pa bes ser ga yang ngas ma mthong*// 'gro drug kun sku khams ci bder bzhugs// zhing skyong kun ci ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// ces smras pas/ bar snang gi lha bran man chad dang*// sa 'og gi klu dang lto 'phye yan chad thams cad tshogs nas/ phyag phyogs med pa thams cad nas phul te/ yang 'di skad du/ gson dang rgyal sras lha yi bu// lha ltung ba'i sdug bsngal bzod glags med// lha ma yin 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal nyon re mongs// mi skye shi'i sdug bsngal bsam las 'das// byol song glen rmugs kyi sdug bsngal rgya re che// yi dwags bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal bsam las 'das/

dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal sun yis thebs// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sun khas 'dzin/ 'gro drug gi pha ma su khas byed// dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang su khas bstod// kyi hud kyi hud sdug re bsngal// zer zhing sdug bsngal byed pa mthong*/ de nas khong rnams sdug bsngal ba'i yul du mthong nas/ khong rnams la lan gzhal ba ni/ spyir rgyal ba'i zhing khams bsam mi khyab/ sgos khyad par 'dzam bu'i gling shed nas// dge bshes grang las 'das pa /chos mdzad bsam gyis mi khyab pas// lung bstan gyi rgyal tshab gzhan du tshol// 'gro drug gi pha ma de ru tshol// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa chos mdzad tsho yis srungs// dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang zhing skyong tsho yis stod// 'gro drug gi pha ma dge bshes tsho yis mdzod// khyed rang tsho ci ltar dga' dga' gyis// kho bos de skad ces smras pas/ yang mkha' 'gro rnams kyis 'di skad du/ dge bshes tsho phrag dog che ba dang*// chos pa tsho 'gran sems che ba yis /'gro drug tsho rgyud ngan rings pa dang*// phan pa'i thabs kyang mi gda' bas// mi khyod la bskul ma cis kyang 'debs/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis de skad zer ba dang*/ khong rnams kyi lan gzhal ba/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus blangs pa mi bdog lags// mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rnyed par dka'// snyigs dus kyi mngal de grib re che// 'das ma 'ongs kyi sems can la 'gro don bya ba dka'// lar khyed de skad zer ba'i ting shed la// rigs ldan gyi pha ma rnyed srid nas// mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dang mjal ba na// zhing skyong kun kyis chos skyong byed lags na// dbang dang bsre ba rdzogs par zhu// brda dang byin rlabs rdzogs par zhu// kho bos de skad ces smras pa'o// de nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis/ bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas// lha dbang bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskur// ā li kā li'i glegs bam mang du bkod nas// rig pa ye shes lnga'i dbang 'di skad// dbang po lnga la ngo sprad nas pha rol du phyin pa'i don dbang yin skad/

skye med don rtogs kyi dbang 'di ni// tshigs su bskur du tshigs lam chad// bar yis mtshon du brda lam chad// dpe yis mtshon du dpe lam chad// 'khrul pas mtshon du 'khrul lam chad// dbang 'di sus kyang bskur du mi 'dod pas// nged kyis zhal chems mtshon ma btub// rang la lhang nge lham mer 'char// sa le sing nge hrig ger 'char// wa le khyug ge lam mer 'char// 'khor 'das kyi snang ba ma nub kyang*// sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las rdzogs par 'byung*// sems can gyi 'gro don de ru grub/ ces gsungs nas/ dbang dang byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad do// de nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod pa ni/ thams cad mgrin gcig tu bsdebs nas/ 'di skad du// gdugs dang zha bu bsil yab dang*// rig pa dngas par byed pa 'di// dbu gdugs lta bu'i bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /gser nya ye shes spyan dang gsal ba yi// nyi zla lta bus ma rig mun pa sel mdzad pa/ spyan gnyis lta bu'i bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /snyan dril ping wang gling bu rol mo'i sgra// rig pa gzings bstod lta bur gyur pa yi/ snyan dril lta bu'i bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis dam pa des kyang = dbu la shang spos dri zhim rnam pa sna tshogs dang*// dbang po dag cing gsal bar gyur pa 'di yi/ shang spos= bkra shis dam pa des kyang = tshem dung rus pa mkhregs par byed pa yi/ sman dang rtsi ru gyur pa gang yin pa/ tshem dung lta bu'i bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis dam pa= ljags la pad ma sbrang rtsi dang*// tshigs dang snyan ngag bde bar 'gyur pa yi// ljags pad ma lta bu'i bkra shis gang lags pa/ bkra shis dam pa= mgur bum rin chen snod dang ni/ bdud rtsi zhal zas skom pa sel yin ba'i mchog 'gur bum lta bu'i bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis dam pa=

phyag 'phrul yi ge bri dang bzo rgyud sna tshogs dang*// dgos 'dod sna tshogs 'byung bar byed pa yi/ phyag 'phrul lta bu'i bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis dam pa des kyang = thugs la dpal be'u snga ma phyi mtha' dran// brjed pa med pa'i rig pa gsal ba dang*/ thugs de dpal 'bar lta bu'i bkra shis gang lags pa/ bkra shis dam pa des kyang = /sku ni rgyal mtshan stag gzig gos dang ldan// mi nub rgyal mtshan lta bu'i nor rdzas dang*// sku ni rgyal mtshan lta bu'i bkra shis gang lags pa/ bkra shis dam pa= zhabs 'khor lo rta dang longs spyod sna tshogs dang*// chos kyi 'khor lo gyur pa'i longs spyod kyis// zhabs 'khor lo lta bur gyur pa'i bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /zer nas bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa mang po brjod cing dgyes pa'i nga ro dbyangs su brjod cing 'dug pa mthong ngo*// re yang re ste byung yang byung*// rin chen 'ja' yi lam sna bdog dal 'byor mi lus blang bdog /mang yul bkra shis kyi gung thang na// ma jo mo bkra shis kyi g.yu chung ma// gangs zhur mo gnas pa'i mdun shed na// 'om lung bkra shis kyi mkhan thang na// pha thig le 'od gsal gyi khang pa bdog /rtsa phu rin chen gyi mche ba gangs/ phu gsum 'doms pa'i klong shod na/ rtsa rlung mi la'i 'khrungs sa bdog /lho ri smug la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa// byang ri dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ ma dgos 'dod lus kyi sgrom bu bdog /zer zhing 'dug pa'i dus su/ 'ja' tshon kha dog sna dgu la byas pa 'di nar gyis byung nas/ khong thams cad 'gro yin 'dug pa mthong ngo*// de'i steng la phyin pas/ shel gyi khang pa gnam sgo yod pa phyogs bzhi steng du/ dkar la dwangs pa/ 'og smug nag tu byas pa/ phyogs thams cad 'ja' tshon du shig ge 'dug pa/ de 'dra ba'i khang pa'i nang na yod tsam na/

'dod chags khrag gi rba rlabs byung zer nas thams cad bros shing 'dug pa mthong*/ der gnam khung dgu pa skas dgu btsugs pa'i skad cig 'dzegs nas phyin pa dang*/ gnam khung chung ngu nas yar ma thar bas/ las kyi rnam smin thar lam dka' zer ba'i sgra gcig byung ba yis/ nag rmug tu song nas brgyal/ dran ba mdo long mdo long byung yis/ nag la mun pa lji zhing 'thibs pa/ khams cung 'tshub pa/ dus da lta dran yang khams cung 'tshub de nas dran pa gsal bar song ba'i tshe/ res 'ga' chu'i rba rlabs spyod pa 'dra/ res 'ga' ri yis mnan pa 'dra res 'ga' tsha zhing bsregs pa 'dra/ res 'ga' grang zhing bskyod pa 'dra/ rang rig 'thom pa'i rlung yang med/ nyon mongs kyi gdug rtsub de na 'dra dus da lta dran yang snying rlung ldang*// zhes pa de yan chod ni bar ma do yin no// da lta ba rnam pa gsum ni gcig ni mgon po byams pa'i drung na*/ byang chub sems dpa' rin chen blo gros zhes bya bar gyur nas/ lha'i lo khri phrag tsam du byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod cing mgon po byams pa'i rjes su byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'dzin ste/ gdul bya 'brel ba yod tshad kyang der 'dren par gsungs pa'o// yang shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams// mun pa rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba na/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul can/ rgyal po pad ma rnam par rol pa zhes bya bar gyur nas/ 'gro ba sems can la phan thogs pa gcig yin par 'dug /'dzam bu'i gling 'di nyid na/ rgya gar nub phyogs kyi grong khyer gcig na/ paṇa ṭi ta lo ka 'gir ti zhes bya bar gyur nas/ gdul bya 'ga' tsam la phan thogs par 'dug /de ni da ltar ba gsum lags so// dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa dang*/ rin po che karma par dbyings su bstan la sogs pa nges yod pa na/ sbungs ri na bzhugs pa'i dus su da ste lo brgya tsam na/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku'i ngo bo/

sa ra ha pa'i thugs kyi sprul pa gcig 'ong nas/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bstan pa rgyas par byed zhes gsungs pa dang*/ dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pas zhwa nag can gsum 'byung zhes gsung pa dang*/ yang rin po che pas slob ma 'ga' la/ rang re yang gangs zhur mo'i phyogs su 'byon zhing dus tshod tsa na rang re la 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung yang shes/ gsung ba la sogs pa don gcig ste/ de'i phyir na rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje yang*/ rje dam pa rin po che bzhugs pa'i gnas nas/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis yang yang du bskul zhing*/ pha ma gnyis la rten 'brel bstan pa ste/ lo gnyis tsam gsum tsam nas dam pa'i gdams pa la blo sbyang zhing*/ rje dam pa'i gdan sar phyin ba'i dus su/ dam pa rin po che'i dag pa'i snang ba dpag tu med pa yun ring du byung zhing*/ rang cag byin rlabs zhugs pa yin snyam ba byung ba'o// de nas bla ma u rgyan pa'i drung du phyin ba'i dus su/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyed byung ba dang nged la dag pa'i snang ba mang po byung gsung ba la sogs pa/ rten 'brel shin tu 'grig cing cung zad bsgoms pa'i dus su/ chos thams cad rgya mtsho'i gting gi chu lta bur ma g.yos par shes pa la sogs pa byung zhing*/ lo drug dang bdun tsam nas mkhan po kun ldan shes rab la rab tu byung zhing*/ 'gro ba dang 'dug pa la sogs pa spyod lam rnam bzhi gang byed kyang*/ thams cad sgyu ma lta bu'i blor dran pa dang*/ de la sogs pa'i yang dag pa'i don yid la mi byed/ de nyid kyi ngang las sgyu ma tsam du/ yang rin po che rgod tshang pa'i bzhugs gnas na yod tsam na/ mi nag po chen po dar nag gi 'jol ber can gcig dang*/ klu rgyal sngags kyi bdag po dang*/ mkhar nag rdo rje rgyal po la sogs pa byung*/ 'gro ran zer ba la sogs par 'dug nas 'ongs pa ste/ de nas 'ongs pa'i dus su bstan pas phyin tsam na/ lha 'dre 'ga' zhig gis bar du gcod pa byed cing 'dug pa la/

bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bzlog pa'o// de nas mtshur phur phyin bla ma ras pa'i bzhugs gnas na yod pa'i dus su/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha la grub thob mang po dang bcas pas bskor ba yid kyi yul na gsal bar byung ba ni/ bla ma'i byin rlabs bzhugs pa'i brda yin par go /yang bkra shis gsar ma na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ bla ma dar ma sgang pa la gtor ma'i byin rlabs byas pa'i tshe/ rdo rje 'chang dang te lo na ro la sogs pa grub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma gnyis su med pa'i snang ba shar ba'i dus su/ 'gro ba 'dren mdzad rdo rje 'chang zhes pa la sogs pa byas pa'o// yang mtshur phu na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ nub gcig gtor ma gcig btang ba tsam na/ dpal mgon po lcam dral dregs pa can pho dgu dang mo dgu ru bcas pa byung zhing*/ dpal dus gsum mkhyen pa'i gdan sa bsrung zhing bskyang ba dang*/ de la sogs pa rdzu 'phul sna tshogs ston zhig 'dug pa ni/ dus skal pa'i bar 'grib tu song bas mi dge ba rtsub 'khrug sna tshogs pa 'ong ba'i brdar 'dug /yang mtshur phu na sa g.yos chen po zhag gcig la yang mang po g.yo'i rgyun ma chad pa byung zhing*/ zla ba gcig gi bar du de ltar du byung ba ni/ cung zad lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de go ba'i snga ltas tsam du 'dug /de nas yang mtshur phu na 'dug pa'i dus su/ rta mgrin zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ g.yas rdo rje tho ba can/ g.yon bsdig 'dzub mdzad pa de lta bu nyams la shar bas/ lha 'dre'i tshogs dbang du sdud cing zil gyis mnan pa'i brdar go /yang mtshur phu na 'dug pa'i dus su/ sprel lo zla ba gsum pa'i nyi shu lnga'i dus/ nam srod kyi dus su dpal mgon po me rlung sub ma'i nang na bzhugs pa/ sku la dar nag gi 'jol ber nor bu rin po ches brgyan pa gsol ba/ phyag g.yas ba dan dkar po rtse gsum pa bsnams pa/ g.yon na thod khrag thogs pa gcig

/'khor dpag tu med pas bskor ba yid kyi yul du gsal ba gcig byung*/ de'i dus su gtor ma btang zhing gsol ba btab pa'i dus na/ dpal mgon po'i zhal nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ci srid gnas kyi bar du/ khyed kyi bu slob yon bdag la sogs pa thams cad nged kyis bsrung ba yin gsung ba snyam byed pa gcig byung*/ de'i dus su dpal mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ hūm̐ gtum chen drag po khros pa srin po'i gzugs/ zhes pa'i bstod pa mdzad do// yang mtshur phu na 'dug pa'i dus su/ sprel lo zla ba gsum pa'i nyi shu brgyad kyi nub mo srod kyi dus su/ nam mkha'i dbyings nas ye shes kyi mgon po nag po ber nag can/ sku mdog smug nag tu 'dug pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan ba gcig gsal bar byung/ de'i mdun na sras mchog nag po ber nag can bzhugs 'dug /de'i 'khor du rnam thos sras kyis 'go byas nas phyogs bcu'i mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi bskor ba de lta bu gsal ba gcig byung*/ de'i dus su hūṃ yab gcig legs ldan nag po chen po ni/ zhes pa la sogs pa'i bstod pa mdzad/ yang mtshur phu na bzhugs pa'i dus su// phyag g.yas na ral gri bsnams pa/ g.yon na thod pa khrag gis bkangs ba bsnams pa/ sku la nyi ma dang zla ba dang skar phran gyis brgyan pa/ de lta bu la 'khor nag mo 'bum sde dang bcas pas bskor ba gsal ba gcig byung*/ de nas gtor ma btang pas gsol ba btab pa'i dus su/ dpal lha mo'i zhal nas khyod kyi bar chad thams cad nga yis bsal gsung ba gcig rmis/ de'i dus su/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs kyi mchog gyur lha mo yi// zhes pa la sogs pa'i bstod pa mdzad/ yang sngags 'chang rang byung rdo rje mtshur phu na bzhugs pa'i dus su sprel lo zla ba dang po'i nub gcig gi dus su dpal lha mo ri ma ti dus gzhi lha mo bcas pa gcig gsal bar byung nas nag mo rdzu 'phrul can la sogs pas bstod pa mdzad/

mtshur phur sprel lo zla ba gsum pa'i gnas ngag gi dus su dpal mgon po ber nag can sku la ber nag gsol ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gri gug thod khrad bsnams pa gsal ba gcig byung ba dang*/ gzhan yang lha mo re ma ti zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma gsal ba gcig byung*/ de'i dus su hūm̐/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po chen po ni/ zhes pa la sogs pa'i bstod pa mdzad/ yang mtshur phu na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ dpal mgon po gar khyug khyug byed pa gcig gsal bar byung*/ de nas gtor ma btang nas gsol ba btab pas/ ma mgon gnyis kyi zhal nas 'gro ba'i don byed pa'i dus la bab pa yin/ gsung ba snyam byed pa'i dus su/ hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni/ zhes pa la sogs pa'i bstod pa mdzad/ yang mtshur phu na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ sprel lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu'i nub mo/ rang cag dang gzhan yang rogs gnyis dang gsum gyis lho phyogs dpal gyi ri yin bya ba gcig tu/ bla ma bram ze chen po tshol du phyin bas/ gzhan rogs gnyis ni ri'i lho phyogs su tshol du song zhing*/ bdag shar phyogs de nyid na thang bde zhing yangs pa gcig tu bsdad tsam na me tog gi char dpag tu med pa bab/ de nas rang cag gis tho mang po rtsigs cing*/ de rnams kyi dkyil du mnyam par bzhag cing 'dug pa la/ nam mkha' nas dbyangs kyi sgra cung zad gcig grags pa la/ rigs kyi bu khyod yar nyon dang*/ bla ma bram ze chen po ni/ rang gi sems nyid yin lags pas// zhes pa la sogs pa bla ma bram ze chen po dang mjal lugs rnams logs su gsal lo// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rang byung rdo rje bdag /'das dang snga phyi legs par mi dran yang*// dad ldan shākya'i dge sbyong dar brtson gyi// nan tan chen pos lo gsum sngon rol nas// yang dang yang du bskul phyir yi ger bkod// 'di byas dge bas 'gro drug ma lus kun// bla med byang chub myur du thob par shog

/chos rje rang byung rdo rje rnam par thar pa 'khrungs rab dang*/ zhal gyis gzigs tshul 'di rnams/ mtshur phu'i dben gnas chen po khyung rdzong dpal gyi dgon par gsal bar bkod pa lags so/ dpal chos rje rang byung rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa bzhugs pa lags so// rdzogs so/// /zhus so//
